result.title: On-Policy Codec Distillation for Efficient All-in-One Video Generation
result.summary: Modern visual generative models operate on tokens, and every visual asset they receive, whether an identity, a scribble, a depth map, or a motion video, is tokenized and appended to the input token sequence. Consequently, conditioning quickly dominates the computation cost. Yet most of these tokens carry redundant spatiotemporal information. Our key insight is that identifying what is genuinely new is exactly the problem that classical video codecs have long solved. Thus, we first introduce a codec-based token pruning method that discards redundant tokens. Then, we propose an on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) strategy to train a DiT adapter capable of learning the codec pruning pattern well without quality degradation. Together, they form On-Policy Codec Distillation (CodecOPSD). We scale CodecOPSD to 16 condition modalities on our own video diffusion model, where it prunes 66% of the condition tokens on average with almost no quality drop. Therefore, denoising becomes 2x faster, and the cache memory shrinks by up to 73% in KV cache mode. CodecOPSD also extends to other state-of-the-art pretrained image and video generative models, where its benefit grows further with more conditions, longer frames, and higher resolution.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 CodecOPSD：先借鉴视频编解码思想剪除条件 token 中的冗余时空信息，再用 on-policy 自蒸馏训练 DiT adapter 适配该剪枝模式，在 16 种条件模态上平均剪掉约 66% 条件 token 而几乎不损生成质量，并加速去噪、压缩 KV cache。
AI.relevance_reason: 「判断哪些信息是真正新增」的剪枝准则与 on-policy 自蒸馏训练压缩适配器的做法，可能为 VLM 推理中的视觉证据筛选、视觉 token 压缩后的信息保真与监督分配提供可核查线索，但其面向生成效率，剪枝是否保留任务必要细节尚需核查。
